Hello,

a bit about me:

My Resume Piano Equestrian

I'm Sophia Rivera, a senior at the American Cooperative School in La Paz, Bolivia, graduating in 2027. Two things have shaped me more than anything else: the piano, which I started at age six, and horseback riding, which I've loved since my first lesson at eight. Piano taught me patience and focus, and riding taught me courage, responsibility, and how to build trust with a partner who can't speak. I'm a curious, hard-working student who brings that same discipline to the classroom, and I'm excited to keep growing at university. Above you can explore my resume, my piano journey, and my life as an equestrian.
